subject: Pre-demo clearance: vendor intake gating and tentative reschedule
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Andrea Lopez <alopez@seaborne.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: demo scheduling blocked by vendor intake items (SOC2/Questionnaire)

Hi Andrea —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood; Ben and I are excited to show the platform to your ops and engineering teams. We have a 60-minute slot penciled for next Tuesday, Oct 12 at 10:00am PT, but the Security & Procurement team here just flagged that our standard demo for healthcare customers requires two intake items to be complete before we can run the live environment demo:

- Completed vendor questionnaire hosted in the vendor portal (we need the tech / data flows answers)
- SOC 2 attestation or evidence of equivalent controls (or, if you prefer, we can accept a signed NDA before the demo and run a redacted walkthrough)

I wanted to surface this now so we can avoid wasting anyone's time. Action options for Seaborne:
1) If your security contact can complete the vendor questionnaire by Mon EOD, we keep the Oct 12 slot.
2) If not, we can sign an NDA in advance and run a redacted demo on Oct 18 or Oct 20 (your preference).
3) Alternatively, we can do a 30-minute executive-level overview this week that requires no intake completion — good for execs but not a technical walkthrough.

I've attached our vendor intake checklist and a draft NDA for review. Ben will coordinate tech attendees and Lauren can cover CS and next-step logistics. Please let us know which option works and the best contact for procurement/security so we can follow up directly.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: redwood-nda-draft.pdf]

From: Andrea Lopez <alopez@seaborne.health>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <vendor-procurement@seaborne.health>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: demo scheduling blocked by vendor intake items (SOC2/Questionnaire)

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the heads-up. Our procurement/security team is swamped this quarter; a few notes from them (copied Procurement above):

- We received your questionnaire link but we need to route it through our vendor portal for tracking. I attempted to upload, but it wants additional attestations and a primary vendor contact.
- SOC 2: we do not publish a SOC 2 externally. We can provide our internal security summary and can execute an NDA, but legal asks for an approved external attestation for any vendor with live PHI access. That may take 2–3 weeks.

Given that timeline, sounds like the Oct 12 live demo will be a stretch. Two asks from our side: 
1) Can Redwood accept a signed NDA now and run a redacted demo for product evaluation next week (no live PHI sample data)?
2) If so, can we tentatively lock Oct 20 at 10:00am PT and switch to a live environment only after procurement confirms SOC2 or equivalent controls?

If you can send an executed NDA (I can get it to legal), we'll proceed with option 1. Otherwise, let's tentatively set Oct 20 and I'll update you as procurement makes progress.

Thanks — Andrea
Andrea Lopez
Director, Platform Integrations | Seaborne Health
alopez@seaborne.health | +1 (415) 555-6789

Thanks for the quick reply and for flagging procurement's timeline. We can absolutely accommodate a redacted demo behind an NDA next week and then follow up with a live walkthrough once your procurement confirms SOC 2 or equivalent. Proposed plan: 

1) We attach an executed NDA now — I've moved the draft to a fillable DocuSign and set the signer as Andrea Lopez (link below). Once signed, we will run a 45-minute redacted technical demo that omits PHI and live connections.
2) Tentatively book the live demo for Tue, Oct 26 at 10:00am PT pending procurement confirmation. If procurement completes earlier, we can swap to a live instance with a 48-hour notice.
3) I'll ask Ben to schedule the tech walkthrough attendees and Lauren will send a brief checklist for what your team should have ready for the live run (keys, test dataset considerations, SSO entrypoint).

DocuSign NDA: https://app.docusign.com/some-link/REDWOOD-SEABORNE-0897
Vendor portal intake form (for your security lead): https://vendorportal.redwood.example.com/forms/SEABORNE-4521

If that plan sounds good I'll: 1) fire the DocuSign, 2) tentatively reserve Oct 26 internally, and 3) Ben will follow up with a calendar invite for the redacted demo once the NDA completes.

Appreciate the coordination — moving to redacted first keeps momentum while procurement works through attestations.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
